photos.title: THE FACE OF BORDER LABOR
photos.description: A young boy holding his shoe-shine box poses for the camera in Elías Piña, a province situated on the Dominican-Haitian border. In this region, characterized by some of the lowest human development indices in the country, the child’s direct gaze reflects the reality of hundreds of minors who enter the informal workforce at an early age to contribute to their families.
